pairs: Woe to the land, that winged cymbal,
which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia,
qui mittit in mare legatos, et in vasis papyri super aquas.
which sends ambassadors by sea and in vessels of papyrus above the waters.
to a nation which has been convulsed and torn apart,
after whom there is no other,
to a nation apprehensive and downtrodden,
whose land the rivers have spoiled.
you who dwell upon the earth:
cum elevatum fuerit signum in montibus,
when the sign will have been elevated on the mountains,
and you will hear the blast of the trumpet.
Quia hæc dicit Dominus ad me:
For the Lord says this to me:
and I will consider in my place,
as the light at midday is clear,
et sicut nubes roris in die messis.
and as a cloud of dew in the day of the harvest.
And it will spring forth with an untimely completion,
and its little branches will be pruned with a curved blade.
And what is left over will be cut away and shaken off.
Et relinquentur simul avibus montium et bestiis terræ;
And together they will be abandoned to the birds of the mountains and to the wild beasts of the earth.
et æstate perpetua erunt super eum volucres,
And the birds will be continuously on them in the summer,
et omnes bestiæ terræ super illum hiemabunt.
and all the wild beasts of the earth will winter over them.
In tempore illo deferetur munus Domino exercituum a populo divulso
a gift will be carried to the Lord of hosts,
from a people divided and torn apart,
after whom there has been no other,
whose land the rivers have ruined,
and it will be carried to the place of the name of the Lord of hosts,
